clues: This adjective for breadth of interest or sympathy traces back to an ancient Greek word meaning 'according to the whole.'
Someone with tastes like this enjoys nearly everything, from opera to punk; it suggests a fuller, more all-embracing range than merely eclectic. Its Greek ancestor meant 'universal.'
